messages:
sam (PM): quick sync: finalizing scope for Dedicated launch. need clarity on burst billing, autoscale fallback, and launch gates by EOD Friday.

oliver (Eng): technical constraints: runtime quota checks must be constant-time. prefer token-bucket in the runtime. also want soft spillover as default; hard preempt behind enterprise flag.

meera (SRE): ops concerns: we need dashboards for contested pools, an automated rollback if p99 latency spikes >20% for 10m, and a customer notify template.

kate (Sales): customers keep asking for "guaranteed burst windows" (3m). some will pay for prewarm. we need a clear invoice model: burst tokens vs hourly prewarm.

sam (PM): proposal: MVP = reserved pools + per-tenant burst credit buckets + proportional spillover fallback. Paid prewarm as add-on. Hard preempt in v1.1.

oliver (Eng): fine. Implementation owners: runtime shim & token-bucket -> @oliver by 2026-04-10; admission controller -> @squad-alloc.

meera (SRE): telemetry owners: emit pool_id, tenant_id, burst_balance, spillover_count, p95/p99. owner: @meera by 2026-04-06.

kate (Sales): billing owner: define burst pricing and invoice preview in console. owner: @kate with finance by 2026-04-08.

sam (PM): launch gates (proposed): 1) p99 token latency delta <= 15% vs baseline on canary for 48h; 2) burst hit-rate >= 95% for credited requests; 3) invoice preview shows sample charge; 4) runbook + dashboards in place.

oliver (Eng): canary plan: runtime shim behind flag, 48h staging replay, automated rollback on safety metric.

meera (SRE): added safety: if cluster GPU util >85% then throttle non-premium bursts. will include in runbook.

sam (PM): all owners OK? please thumbs.

oliver (Eng): :thumbsup:

meera (SRE): :thumbsup:

kate (Sales): :thumbsup: (will flag one account that needs hard preempt soon)

opsbot: Thread archived after 7 days of inactivity.
